title: KestrelCare Adjuster Note: Long Diagnoses
content:
**Note.** On a KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts repair order, the diagnostic hours are adjusted for a long diagnosis, counted in calendar days from the failure date to the decision date of the plan's most recent approved claim decision: beyond 5 days (the prolonged-diagnosis days) the hours are multiplied by the prolonged-diagnosis multiplier of 1.5; beyond 2 days (the extended-diagnosis days) but not beyond 5 days the extended-diagnosis hours of 1.0 hour are added; otherwise the hours stand as they are.

The adjustment acts on the whole of the diagnostic hours allowed on the repair order.

| Calendar days from failure date to decision date | Diagnostic hours |
|---|---|
| 0 to 2 | unchanged |
| 3 to 5 | plus 1.0 hour |
| 6 or more | multiplied by 1.5 |

*Hypothetical:* 2.5 hours allowed, failure on 4 June: decided 6 June, 2.5 hours; decided 9 June, 3.5 hours; decided 10 June, 3.75 hours.
